notations.name: recipe
notations.description: Cooking recipe: ingredients as objects with name (string), quantity (positive number, booleans rejected), unit (string); steps as an ordered non-empty list of non-empty strings.

notations.name: court-docket
notations.description: Court docket: issue (non-empty string), parties and evidence as non-empty string lists, ruling (non-empty string), remedies as a non-empty string list.

notations.name: knitting-pattern
notations.description: Knitting pattern: gauge object with stitches_per_inch and rows_per_inch (positive numbers), stitches as a non-empty string list, repeat and bind_off as non-empty strings.

notations.name: chess-annotation
notations.description: Chess annotation: moves as a non-empty list of objects with move and countermove (non-empty strings) and evaluation (number, booleans rejected).

notations.name: liturgical-rubric
notations.description: Liturgical rubric: cues as a non-empty list of objects with cue, officiant, response, and rubric (all non-empty strings).

notations.name: flight-checklist
notations.description: Flight checklist: checks as a non-empty list of objects with trigger, challenge, expected_response, verify, and abort (all non-empty strings).

notations.name: circuit-diagram
notations.description: Circuit diagram: nodes as a non-empty list of unique non-empty string IDs; connections as a non-empty list of directed objects with from and to referencing declared node IDs.
